actions.text: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_users FROM users;
SELECT DISTINCT country FROM users WHERE country LIKE '%US%' OR country LIKE '%United%';
SELECT ROUND(SUM(p.total_amount), 2) AS total_revenue FROM purchases p JOIN users u ON p.user_id = u.user_id WHERE u.country = 'USA';
SELECT SUM(p.total_amount) FROM purchases p JOIN users u ON p.user_id = u.user_id WHERE u.country = 'USA';
SELECT u.username, u.user_id, SUM(p.total_amount) as total_spent FROM users u JOIN purchases p ON u.user_id = p.user_id GROUP BY u.user_id, u.username ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 5;

SELECT u.username, u.user_id, SUM(p.total_amount) as gross_spent, COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_amount), 0) as total_refunded, SUM(p.total_amount) - COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_amount), 0) as net_spent FROM users u JOIN purchases p ON u.user_id = p.user_id LEFT JOIN refunds r ON p.purchase_id = r.purchase_id GROUP BY u.user_id, u.username ORDER BY net_spent DESC LIMIT 5;

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE product_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT product_id FROM purchases);
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products p LEFT JOIN purchases pu ON p.product_id = pu.product_id WHERE pu.product_id IS NULL;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT p.user_id FROM purchases p JOIN products pr ON p.product_id = pr.product_id GROUP BY p.user_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pr.category) >= 4);
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM refunds;

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT p.user_id FROM purchases p JOIN products pr ON p.product_id = pr.product_id WHERE p.purchase_id NOT IN (SELECT purchase_id FROM refunds) GROUP BY p.user_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pr.category) >= 4);
SELECT * FROM refunds LIMIT 5;
SELECT MIN(quantity), MIN(total_amount) FROM purchases;
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', purchase_date) AS month, SUM(total_amount) AS revenue FROM purchases WHERE purchase_date LIKE '2024%' GROUP BY month ORDER BY revenue DESC

SELECT u.user_id, u.username, SUM(p.total_amount) AS total_spend, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.total_amount) DESC) as rnk, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.total_amount) DESC) as dense_rnk, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.total_amount) DESC) as row_num FROM users u JOIN purchases p ON u.user_id = p.user_id GROUP BY u.user_id, u.username ORDER BY total_spend DESC

SELECT u.country, SUM(p.total_amount) AS total_purchases, COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_amount), 0) AS total_refunds, SUM(p.total_amount) - COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_amount), 0) AS net_revenue FROM users u JOIN purchases p ON u.user_id = p.user_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT purchase_id, SUM(refund_amount) AS refund_amount FROM refunds GROUP BY purchase_id) r ON p.purchase_id = r.purchase_id GROUP BY u.country ORDER BY net_revenue DESC LIMIT 5;
